nodes.label: Default Android launcher icon (xxhdpi): stock Android Studio template icon showing the white Android robot head (bugdroid) with antennae and green eyes on a flat green grid background with rounded corners and a diagonal long-shadow. This is NOT custom Minima branding — the Minima Core node app (org.minimarex.minimacore) ships the unmodified template launcher icon at this density, indicating the app's launcher branding was never customized.
